scope: Minimum accepted matrix and observed implementation behavior on the archived host; no universal proof of unsafe/native behavior or performance readiness
decision_basis: Named feature inspection and corrected retained assessments, approved frozen supplementary views, exact primary preservation and restoration, independent reference/runtime checks, complete positive workloads, three identical eligible observations where required, and faithful insufficient calibration outcomes
existing_behavior: Retained face and generation admission plus all five Light Atelier cases at both resolutions, interactive controls/lighting/reset review; see indexed supporting artifacts and allowance log entries
failure_reference_search_reproduction: Retained independent reference, numeric/rollback, injected failure, search/recovery and archived reproduction checks; current full suite passes. See indexed corroboration and supporting artifacts.
retention: Earlier failed, incomplete and insufficient attempts remain indexed. Noneligible pending reviews cannot establish acceptance. No timing populations or calibration controls are pooled into a performance pass.
